Rather than delivering presentations or facilitating group consensus sessions, we produce memoranda that are authored and signed by a single individual. This philosophy rests on the conviction that a well reasoned, seven page document is more valuable than a forty page slide deck that only circles a question.
Working with clients managing governance transitions and strategic shifts, we prioritize absolute discretion and honesty. The work at JHC Consulting is precise. Familiarity with generative models is useful, but we value core reasoning skills above specific technical certifications.

This is a fully remote position that offers a significant amount of autonomy. We cultivate a work environment centered on deep work rather than frequent meetings. This is an opportunity to contribute to high level advisory work while developing a disciplined approach to analysis. We offer a professional atmosphere where the focus remains entirely on the quality of the written record. Success in this role is measured by the clarity of your findings and the reliability of your research. This environment is ideal for those who prefer to think deeply before they write.
